A Mom, Three Sons, And A Dream

Meet the Family Behind Bloomin' Blinds Brand

What started as a mother’s one-woman blind repair business in 1993 has grown into a national franchise with 60+ locations — still run by the same family that started it all.

Where It All Began

Built From The Ground Up

  • Karen McGuffin started cleaning and repairing blinds in 1993 in Seattle, Washington — just her, a van, and an instinct for business. After building and selling that first blind cleaning company over eight years, she saw something bigger.
  • This time, she brought her three sons along for the ride. Together, they launched Bloomin' Blinds — a family business built on honest service, real craftsmanship, and the belief that window coverings could be done better.

Karen McGuffin

Entrepreneur / Founder

  • Karen started fixing blinds in 1993 with a van, a toolkit, and an instinct for business. After building and selling her first blind cleaning company in Seattle, she launched Bloomin' Blinds with her three sons. Proud of what she started within the family, she is actively enjoying retirement and her 4 grandchildren.
Fun Fact: Karen has built and sold businesses across four different industries — blinds, apparel, pizza, and franchising.

Kelsey Stuart

Co-Founder

  • Kelsey spent nearly 20 years building and developing the company alongside his family. At one point leading Development efforts as well as Executive leadership. Today, Kelsey enjoys the mountains of Montana and assisting new franchise owners achieve their dream through franchised business ownership.
Guiding Principle: "Leads the corporate franchise team as the example, rather than the exception."

Kristopher (Kris) Stuart

Co-Founder / CEO

  • Kristopher was the company's first employee. Nearly 25 years later, he finds himself at the helm of the organization. With a focus on franchisee-first decision making, he applies the same commitment to the mission that drove his more than 12 years as a firefighter and paramedic in Texas. That crucible-tested ability to stay goal oriented against significant distraction keeps Kris focused on franchisee success and on maximizing the revenue opportunity of every customer experience.
Double Duty: Career Firefighter/Paramedic, Engine Co. Lieutenant - while growing the original location to $3M/year

Kevin Stuart

Co-Founder / Chief Technology Officer

  • Kevin is the franchise network's go-to technical expert — the person franchise owners call when they need help solving a tricky repair. As Chief Technology Officer, he develops the field-tested methods that empower our owners to handle on-site service challenge with total confidence.
Role: First point of call for technical support across the entire franchise network.

What We Stand For

Our Values

Local Heart

  • The van in your driveway is owned by someone in your community. You get the care of a neighbor and the standards of a national brand.

Honest Always

  • If a repair will fix it, we will say so. If you need new treatments, we will tell you that too. No upselling, no pressure.

Built to Last

  • Our products, our relationships, and our business. We are in this for the long haul.

Become Part Of The Story

Want to Join the Family?

  • If you have ever dreamed of owning your own business backed by a family that actually cares, we would love to talk.
